parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) A train is travelling at v metres per second. Find an expression, in terms of v , for the speed of the train in kilometres per hour. Give your answer in its simplest form. ............................................km/h [2]

content.tex: A train is travelling at \(v\) metres per second.
Find an expression, in terms of \(v\) , for the speed of the train in kilometres per hour. Give your answer in its simplest form.
